title: Rear setback (R10-R15)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. ii. For R10-R25, the stated setback distances may be reduced by half the width of an adjoining pedestrian access way to a maximum reduction of 2m (refer to Figure 3.4d). Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, rear setback: 3m (applicable to R10-R15 only).

replaces.note: R15 rear by the Tables 2a/2b wall matrix -> flat 3 m (may tighten for low walls)
R10-R25 reduction by half an adjoining ROW, pedestrian access way, communal street or battleaxe leg -> pedestrian access way only (C4P1-089)

verified.note: Table 3.4a (p32) rear cell is one merged cell across all wall heights reading '3m (applicable to R10-R15 only)'; Table 4A (p7) prints 6m as one merged cell spanning R10, R12.5 and R15 and all three wall-height rows. Draft conflict; Table 3.4a encoded.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#rear (R2 10 m and R2.5 7.5 m rows dropped). Table 3.4a (p32) rear column: 3 m 'applicable to R10-R15 only', all wall heights. CONFLICT: Table 4A (p7) shows 6 m at R10-R15 (register C4P1-003 conflict 2); Table 3.4a is encoded. Pedestrian access way reduction (C3.4.1(ii), R10-R25, max 2 m) as an exception.
